parameters.name: ArtifactBuildProperty
parameters.description: The content used to build the artifact. This parameter is used for managed artifact builds.

parameters.name: ArtifactBuildType
parameters.description:
The type of the artifact to be built. Valid values:

- EcsImage: builds an ECS image.

- Dockerfile: builds a container image based on a Dockerfile.

- Buildpacks: builds a container image based on Buildpacks.

- ContainerImage: builds a container image by renaming an existing container image.

parameters.name: ArtifactId
parameters.description:
The artifact ID.

This parameter is required to create a new version of an existing artifact.

You can call the [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) operation to obtain the artifact ID.

parameters.name: ArtifactType
parameters.description:
The artifact type.

Valid values:

- EcsImage: an ECS image artifact.

- AcrImage: a container image artifact.

- File: an Object Storage Service (OSS) file artifact.

- Script: a script artifact.

- HelmChart: a Helm chart artifact.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SupportRegionIds
parameters.description: The regions where the image can be distributed.

parameters.name: VersionName
parameters.description: The name of the artifact version.
